data.summary:
78 6
Senior .NET Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET, Azure Cloud, Angular, Microservices, SQL Server, Power Apps, Power BI, Microsoft Power Automate, SharePoint, Docker, and Kubernetes leveraging AI- powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Claude AI, and OpenAI APIs to improve code quality, accelerate development, generate unit tests, and enhance productivity. Proven expertise in building scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions across Automotive, Payments, Banking, Cards, Retail, and Healthcare domains.
Experienced in developing RESTful APIs, cloud-native applications, distributed systems, and microservices architectures, with strong knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, system integration, database optimization, and cloud- based enterprise solutions. Hands-on experience in delivering business-critical applications involving vehicle and manufacturing management systems, automotive digital platforms, payment processing, core banking operations, card management systems, customer onboarding, retail business solutions, healthcare workflows, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of SOLID principles, Design Patterns, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams, product owners, business stakeholders, and global teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and customer-centric solutions that improve operational efficiency, system performance, and business growth.
